name: Cardinal Tetra (Paracheirodon axelrodi)
description: Soft-water Amazonian relative of the neon tetra; iridescent blue stripe runs the full body and a red ventral half stretches head-to-tail. Famous for dense shoaling — keeps tighter formations than neons (wCoh override 1.4). Prefers warmer, more acidic water than the neon and is the better pick for blackwater biotopes.
